I am a massage therapist, researcher and educator who teaches evidence-based continuing education courses for healthcare professionals.
I teach courses for massage and manual therapists on the subjects of chronic pain management and the integration of research evidence to clinical best practices for the assessment, treatment and rehab for the neck, shoulder, lower back, pelvis, TMJ and headaches.
Here you can also find my podcast episodes, Massage Science.
